notes.title: Major bug fixes in update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

Goetia 2 has been live for more than a month now, and we hope most of you enjoyed wandering Venice's weirdest places, coping with Buer's cryptic conversation, following the trials of Luca and Daphne and helping them overcome them. But we know that some of you have experienced some bugs that prevented you from enjoying the game, or even finishing it. We've worked since launch to address these, and we'd first like to thank all of you who took the time to report those, and even help us uncover some tricky issues.

Patch 1.1 is live now, and fixes the great majority of these game-breaking bugs. You can find the full patch notes here. 

We will keep working to fix the smaller issues. We're sorry it was necessary in the first place, and we hope you'll now be willing to experience the game as we intended it to be.

Venice awaits you!
